title: Shield Bash Revived
description: Add a Shield Bash ability to all shields in Minecraft 1.21.1 (NeoForge), with knockback, AoE damage, a 2-second cooldown, durability cost, and a sweep attack sound.
body:
Description

Shield Bash adds a new combat mechanic to every shield in Minecraft. While blocking, players can perform a powerful shield slam that knocks back nearby enemies, deals area damage, consumes shield durability, and triggers a short cooldown with immersive sound effects.
